scope: Sampled resident and private commit of the serial JAX worker process tree during this case, including persistent interpreter allocations; other applications and ParaView are excluded.
guard_scope: Only the owned worker process tree is stopped; completed frame checkpoints are retained.
monitoring_recovery: Previous monitor process exited after Windows denied replacement of its JSON report; numerical worker continued.
backup_guard_scope: Independent one-second memory-only loop with shared-memory heartbeat; disk reports are written by a separate thread every 30 seconds.
